key_derivation: src/opcode_list.h is a pure x-macro list of OP(name, imm, in, out) lines (src/opcode_list.h:1-...), so the complete set of files that SEE a definition is exactly the includers: `grep -rn 'opcode_list.h' src/` returns src/bytecode.h:9 (OP -> enum member, src/bytecode.h:8), src/bytecode.h:16 (OP -> +1, the opcode count, src/bytecode.h:15) and src/bytecode.c:23 (OP -> descriptor table row, src/bytecode.c:19) and nothing else.
